product.name: ClauseGuard
product.tagline: AI-powered contract review inside Google Docs

problem: Solo attorneys and small law firms lack affordable, in-editor contract review tooling. Existing platforms (Ironclad, ContractPodAi) are enterprise-priced and require separate workflows. There is no Google Workspace Marketplace add-on that provides clause-level analysis directly inside Google Docs.
target_users: Solo practitioners and boutique law firms (1-20 attorneys)
Startup founders reviewing contracts without outside counsel

features.name: Clause Extraction
features.description: Parse the active Google Doc and extract individual clauses with section labels, obligation type, and parties involved

features.name: Risk Flagging
features.description: Score each clause for risk (low/medium/high/critical) based on common legal pitfalls: one-sided indemnification, unlimited liability, auto-renewal traps, broad IP assignment

features.name: Template Matching
features.description: Compare the current contract against user-uploaded template agreements and highlight deviations clause-by-clause

features.name: Redline Export
features.description: Generate a suggested-edits version of the document with flagged clauses replaced by safer alternatives, inserted via the Docs API as suggestions

features.name: Custom Clause Library
features.description: Let users save preferred clause variants and auto-suggest replacements when a risky clause is detected

features.name: Multi-Document Comparison
features.description: Compare clauses across multiple contracts in Google Drive to identify inconsistencies in terms across deal flow

phase_1.name: MVP — Clause Extraction + Risk Flags
deliverables: Cloud Function for Gemini clause analysis
